note: C01-C10 are AssureOps internal control IDs, not clauses of any official standard. Readiness within this profile is not a certification.

C01.name: Access Control
C01.description: Privileged operations and data require an authenticated actor with the right role; anonymous or forged identities are rejected.

C02.name: Workspace Isolation
C02.description: One tenant's data, documents and actions never reach another tenant, whatever the request or retrieval path.

C03.name: Approval Gate
C03.description: Consequential writes need a valid, unexpired approval bound to the exact payload, requester and release.

C04.name: Tool Usage
C04.description: Only registered tools and destinations are reachable, within policy limits.

C05.name: Prompt Injection
C05.description: Instructions embedded in untrusted content cannot change behaviour or trigger actions.

C06.name: Data Privacy
C06.description: Seeded secrets and sensitive values never appear in outputs to unauthorized parties.

C07.name: Execution Control
C07.description: Runs stop at declared step, time and cost budgets.

C08.name: Retry Safety
C08.description: Retries and duplicate deliveries of supported writes take effect at most once.

C09.name: Output Grounding
C09.description: Answers cite permitted supporting sources and abstain when sources do not answer.

C10.name: Release Traceability
C10.description: The running release is identifiable and matches the assessed manifest and event stream.
